name: Skeptic
reason: The history rate of 0.667 looks alarming, but a 18.5C late-October week with no hot days and almost no runoff offers little fuel, and a satellite index that barely moved is hardly a smoking gun.
evidence: max_temp_avg 18.5 with hot_days 0 suggests cooling, not bloom-friendly heat
rain_last_14d_mm 1.7 and heavy_rain_days 0 mean negligible nutrient runoff
cyano_index 0.064 with change_vs_last_week only +0.007 is a weak, near-flat signal
bloom_rate_this_month_past_years 0.667 is the one real point for a bloom, but it is a historical base rate, not this week's observation
